title: Sump Pump Installation: Basin Prep, Filtration, and Exterior Discharge Piping (This Old House)

locations.name: concrete floor (indoor utility area)
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly shows digging a hole in the concrete floor to install the sump basin; no explicit shooting location is given beyond indoor-utility context.

summary: The video demonstrates a practical, step-by-step installation of a submersible sump pump in an indoor concrete floor setting. It covers brief pump operation with a float switch, creating a flush sump basin in a concrete floor, and preparing the basin with filtration to keep sediment out. A stone bed and a manufacturer-recommended top paver are used to level and protect the basin and impeller. The discharge is routed through a check valve and PVC piping with a 45-degree elbow up the foundation, then extended to grade outside to slope away from the structure. The presenter tests the pump and explains how the float trigger responds to rising water, with a note on perimeter-drain behavior that activates the pump as the water table changes.
